response.justification: While Bogdan is an accomplished senior software engineer with 20 years of experience, he fundamentally does not meet the mandatory technical requirements for this capital markets C++ role. The position requires 5–10 years of strong hands-on C++ development on Windows; his resume shows only approximately 6 months of professional C++ work at National Instruments. He also lacks demonstrated expertise in SQL Server/Oracle databases and has no background in capital markets, fixed income, or investment banking—his career has concentrated on web development (JavaScript/TypeScript/Node.js). The gap between his specialization and the role's core requirements is too substantial.
strengths: Extensive 20-year career with progression to senior/staff levels, demonstrating sustained technical excellence and professional growth
Strong ability to rapidly learn and apply diverse technology stacks and adapt to different problem domains throughout career
Excellent communication and mentoring skills demonstrated through technical workshops, conference presentations, and leadership roles
concerns: Critical gap in C++ expertise: only ~6 months of professional development versus the required 5–10 years of hands-on experience
No demonstrated experience with Windows platform development or SQL Server/Oracle databases—both mandatory requirements
Complete absence of capital markets, fixed income, or investment banking domain knowledge, eliminating the alternative qualification pathway
